solutions.title: DP array
solutions.strategy: Store the best total through every prefix and choose between skipping or taking each value.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each house contributes one DP transition.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP array stores one value for each prefix.

solutions.title: Rolling two-state DP
solutions.strategy: Keep only the best totals for the previous and previous-previous prefixes.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP state is compressed into two integers.
